trends.trendName: Guaranteed lump sum at income start
trends.whatProductOffers: At the start of the income period the policy pays a guaranteed cash payment in one lump sum equal to 10, 15 or 20 times the guaranteed Monthly Income, depending on the income period chosen.
exclusionsOrConditions: The payment is calculated on the guaranteed Monthly Income amount, not the total Monthly Income.
The client may take it in cash or leave it with AIA to earn interest.
Outstanding debt is deducted before payment.
